paragraphs.notes: Transcribed from the page image; this sheet has no usable text layer. The EPO logo, the stylised concentric-arc mark, sits at the left of this block. It is a device mark rather than text or chemistry, so it is not recorded as a drawing. 'Nummer der Anmeldung' and the number itself are printed in the monospaced typewriter face the EPO uses for filled-in fields, which is how the filled fields can be told apart from the pre-printed form throughout this sheet. The application number EP 07 01 6606 is the application this search report belongs to and matches the number printed on the annex page p22.

There is no text layer on this page at all (the extracted text for p21 is 19 characters, the running header and the page number), so the image is the only source for every character in this table. Each citation block is closed on the page by a short dashed rule printed as five hyphens, '-----', centred under the entry; those rules are separators, not content, and are not reproduced in the markdown. The 'Betrifft Anspruch' value is 1-16 for all four citations, and the application has 16 claims, so every cited document is cited against the whole claim set. The IPC classification and the searched fields are printed in a separate boxed column at the right of the same table and are appended here rather than given their own paragraph, so that they travel with the table they belong to.

paragraphs.zh:
KATEGORIE DER GENANNTEN DOKUMENTE
X : von besonderer Bedeutung allein betrachtet
Y : von besonderer Bedeutung in Verbindung mit einer anderen Veröffentlichung derselben Kategorie
A : technologischer Hintergrund
O : nichtschriftliche Offenbarung
P : Zwischenliteratur
T : der Erfindung zugrunde liegende Theorien oder Grundsätze
E : älteres Patentdokument, das jedoch erst am oder nach dem Anmeldedatum veröffentlicht worden ist
D : in der Anmeldung angeführtes Dokument
L : aus anderen Gründen angeführtes Dokument
& : Mitglied der gleichen Patentfamilie, übereinstimmendes Dokument
paragraphs.en:
CATEGORY OF CITED DOCUMENTS
X : particularly relevant if taken alone
Y : particularly relevant if combined with another document of the same category
A : technological background
O : non-written disclosure
P : intermediate document
T : theory or principle underlying the invention
E : earlier patent document, but published on or after the filing date
D : document cited in the application
L : document cited for other reasons
& : member of the same patent family, corresponding document
paragraphs.notes: The legend is printed in two columns, X/Y/A/O/P on the left and T/E/D/L on the right, with the '&' entry below a row of dots that separates it from the four above it on the right. The two columns are given here one after the other because they are a single flat legend, not a two-dimensional table. This is boilerplate on every EPO search report and carries no information specific to this application; it is transcribed so that downstream passes can drop it knowingly rather than never having seen it. It is also the key to the 'Kategorie' column of the table above: the two X citations, WO 03/047340 and WO 2007/006415, are the ones the examiner considered particularly relevant taken alone.

Printed vertically, reading bottom to top, in the left margin near the foot of the sheet. A bare numeral '4' is printed in the left margin just above it, level with the 'Der vorliegende Recherchenbericht' row; it is the EPO form's own section marker for that band of the form and is not a page number, a claim number or a reference numeral. Both are form furniture rather than content.

discrepancies.what: The task briefing states that pages 15 to 22 are the eight figure sheets carrying the six Abbildungen, and that p21 is a spectrum sheet with no text. The page is not a figure sheet and carries no spectrum.
discrepancies.drawing_says: p21 is the EPO search report sheet, EPO FORM 1503, headed EUROPÄISCHER RECHERCHENBERICHT for application EP 07 01 6606. It is dense with text: a four-row citation table, the IPC boxes, the place, date and examiner row, and the category legend. It prints no figure label, no axes and no plotted curve.
discrepancies.text_says: VISION-BRIEF.md, section 'What this patent is, so you are not surprised': 'Pages 15 to 22 carry no text at all beyond the running header, and they are the six Abbildungen of [0018]'. The task prompt likewise asserts 'This is a figure sheet' and 'Your page has no text layer. It carries exactly 19 characters'.

discrepancies.what: The premise behind the briefing's page range is nonetheless half right, and the half that is right explains the other half. p21 genuinely has a 19-character text layer, but the reason is that the search report is appended to the A1 publication as a scanned image, not that the sheet is blank.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Every character on p21 is pixels. The citation table, the legend and the examiner's name are all image, which is why the extractor found only the running header 'EP 2 045 236 A1' and the page number '21'.
discrepancies.text_says: VISION-BRIEF.md correction 2: 'This patent is born digital, not scanned. It has a clean text layer of 47,791 characters.' That holds for pages 1 to 14 and not for pages 15 to 22, and an absent text layer was read as an absent page.

discrepancies.what: The figure sheets are p15 to p20, six sheets for six Abbildungen, one to one, and not eight sheets for six as the briefing states. This was checked against the neighbouring pages rather than assumed.
discrepancies.drawing_says: p20 prints the label 'Fig. 3a' and plots an infrared spectrum, absorbance 0.0 to about 0.4 on the ordinate against 'Wellenzahl cm-1' running from about 3500 down to below 1000 on the abscissa, the sheet rotated to landscape. 'Fig. 3a' is the sixth and last Abbildung of [0018], so the run of figure sheets ends at p20. p22 is headed 'ANHANG ZUM EUROPÄISCHEN RECHERCHENBERICHT ÜBER DIE EUROPÄISCHE PATENTANMELDUNG NR. EP 07 01 6606' and tabulates the patent families of the four documents cited on p21.
discrepancies.text_says: VISION-BRIEF.md: 'There are eight figure sheets for six Abbildungen, so the mapping from sheet to Abbildung is NOT one to one'. On the evidence of p20 and p22 the mapping is one to one over p15 to p20, and p21 and p22 are the search report and its family annex.

discrepancies.what: The page prints no figure label, because it is not a figure. The task asked for the label verbatim if one is printed and for an explicit statement if none is.
discrepancies.drawing_says: No 'Abbildung' and no 'Fig.' appears anywhere on p21. The only large-type headings are 'EUROPÄISCHER RECHERCHENBERICHT' and 'EINSCHLÄGIGE DOKUMENTE'.
discrepancies.text_says: The task asked which Abbildung this sheet is. It is none of them, and no Abbildung number can be assigned to it.

discrepancies.what: 'drawings' is empty, and the empty array is a finding rather than an omission. The task asked that this be stated on the grounds that the sheet carries a spectrum and no chemical structure; the true grounds are stronger, because the sheet carries neither.
discrepancies.drawing_says: p21 carries no chemical structure, no reaction scheme and no plotted spectrum. Its whole content is a printed EPO form: ruled boxes, a four-row citation table, two IPC boxes, an examiner row and a category legend. Nothing on it belongs in the 'structures' schema of rings and substituents, and nothing on it is a curve against axes either. The searchable content of the sheet is the citation table, and per the shared briefing that table has been carried inside the 'zh' and 'en' of its paragraph so that it reaches the downstream passes, which have no representation for a table of their own.
discrepancies.text_says: The task prompt required drawings to be [] with a note that the sheet carries a spectrum. It is [] for a different reason, and recording the stated reason would have put a false statement into the artifact.

blank_line_note: Blank lines inside paragraph zh/en were removed by the run owner. They came from the markdown-table convention this run uses to carry table content in the paragraph. build_enriched.py emits them into the enriched document, but english_by_line() in resolve_translations.py builds its `body` with `if t.strip()`, dropping blanks, while splitting the paragraph without dropping them. Any interior blank line therefore desynchronised the walk and it aborted, by design rather than guessing, which blocked verify.py for the whole run. Only whitespace-only lines were removed; every character of content is unchanged, asserted at the time of the edit.
